title: Cholesky Factor
prompt:
Find the lower-triangular Cholesky factor L (positive diagonal) with L·Lᵀ = A:

    A = [[16, 16], [16, 25]]
recap: A symmetric positive-definite A factors uniquely as A = L·Lᵀ with L lower-triangular, positive diagonal. Solve row by row: l₁₁ = √A₁₁, l₂₁ = A₂₁/l₁₁, l₂₂ = √(A₂₂ − l₂₁^2).
